name: Renewables IPP with battery
title: Renewables IPP + battery
note: A wind and solar plant with an optional battery behind one grid connection. Size the battery and weigh PPA against merchant revenue.
detail: 60 MW wind and 50 MWp PV behind a 70 MW export limit, with a battery candidate up to 50 MW at 2 h. The site and prices are illustrative: bring your own price series.
artTitle: Renewables IPP with battery — original illustrative scene
presetNote: Suggested: capacity planning and the commercial case (PPA and merchant revenue; the investment case once available). Grid and control studies are off: switch Grid on later if you need the connection studied. No reliability study: the site has no load.
